_comment: Merge these hooks into ~/.claude/settings.json (or .claude/settings.json) using the update-config skill. Stop: writes the summary of whatever run is currently in flight. There is no PreToolUse/PostToolUse guard here — see _v7_note.
_v7_note: Earlier drafts of this file shipped a PreToolUse write-block for the main orchestrator and a PostToolUse `aidp scope check` hook, both armed on AIDP_RUN/AIDP_STAGE being non-empty. Those variables are only ever written into the sub-agent PROMPT TEXT, never into the hook's process environment, so the guard condition could never be satisfied — the hooks were dead weight, not a working safety net. Both guard hooks have been removed for good (not re-armed on a new marker); scope enforcement runs after the fact instead (see `aidp doctor`). The one hook that remains, Stop, calls `aidp run summary` with no `--run`, which resolves the in-flight run itself and prints nothing when there is none — so this hook is silent outside a pipeline and needs no shell-side JSON parsing or file test. It used to read `.aidp/run-in-flight` out of the repo by path; that marker now lives in the vault (`<vault>/Pipelines/<repo>/.state/run-in-flight`, written by `aidp workflow emit`, cleared by `aidp run reconcile`) because v7 writes nothing into the target working tree, and a hook has no business knowing where aidp keeps its state. One consequence worth having: the command is now identical on every platform, so there is no `_windows_command` variant to keep in sync.
